newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindustan Zinc plans output rise-paper.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindustan Zinc plans output rise-paper.

text.p: State-run Hindustan Zinc plans to increase output of zinc and lead by 22 percent in 1997/98 (April-March) fiscal year, the Financial Express newspaper reported on Sunday.
The company expects to produce 170,000 tonnes of metal in the coming fiscal year, the report said.
According to a memorandum of understanding signed between the government and the company, Hindustan Zinc will increase sales of metal by 20 percent to 160,000 tonnes.
The company also plans to increase capacity at its Rampura Aghua mine from 3,000 tonnes a day to 4,500.
There are also plans to increase capacity at the company's zinc smelter and begin exploration for gold in Vietnam in 1997/98, the report said.
